title: Full Stack Developer – AI/LLM Applications
description:
**Experience:** 
 3–4 years
 



**Location:** 
 Bangalore
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 We are looking for a hands\-on
 **Full Stack Developer – AI/LLM Applications** 
 to build and operate product features end\-to\-end.
 



  





 You will own features across
 **frontend, backend, databases, AI/LLM integrations, testing, deployment and production support** 
 . The role is suited for an engineer who enjoys taking ownership of a feature from an incomplete requirement through development, release and continuous improvement.
 



  





**Mandatory:** 
**Hands\-on experience integrating AI or LLM services into production applications is required. Candidates with only academic, experimental or personal\-project experience with AI/LLMs will not be considered.** 




  





 You should understand that building an AI feature involves more than connecting an API. It requires structured outputs, validation, evaluation, error handling, security, monitoring and cost management.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* Design and build responsive web applications using
 **React.js, Next.js or similar frameworks** 
 .
* Develop backend services and REST APIs using
 **Node.js, Express.js or similar technologies** 
 .
* Own features from technical design through development, testing, deployment and production monitoring.
* Design data models and queries for
 **SQL or NoSQL databases** 
 .
* Integrate external APIs with authentication, validation, retries, rate\-limit handling and logging.
* Build AI\-assisted features using
 **LLM APIs, embeddings, retrieval, tool calling or workflow orchestration** 
 .
* Implement prompt versioning, structured responses, output validation, guardrails and fallback mechanisms.
* Evaluate AI output quality and monitor latency, token usage and cost.
* Write and maintain
 **unit, integration and end\-to\-end tests** 
 .
* Investigate production issues, identify root causes and implement reliable fixes.
* Improve application performance, reliability, security and observability.
* Review code and contribute to technical architecture and release decisions.
* Work closely with product, design, QA and engineering teams to resolve requirements and delivery risks.



  





**Required Experience** 




  




* **3–4 years of full\-stack development experience.**
* Strong fundamentals in
 **JavaScript and TypeScript** 
 .
* Production experience with
 **React.js, Next.js or a similar frontend framework** 
 .
* Production experience with
 **Node.js, Express.js and REST APIs** 
 .
* Experience with
 **PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB or a similar database** 
 .
* **Hands\-on experience integrating AI or LLM services into production applications or workflows.**
* Understanding of
 **prompt design, structured outputs, retrieval, evaluation, guardrails and human review** 
 .
* Experience with Git, automated testing, application security, deployment and production debugging.
* Ability to convert incomplete requirements into a technical plan and deliver with limited supervision.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and clear written and verbal communication.



  





**Preferred Experience** 




  




* Docker and CI/CD pipelines.
* AWS, Azure or Google Cloud Platform.
* SaaS, workflow or enterprise application development.
* Vector databases and Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG).
* LLM observability or evaluation frameworks.
* Queue\-based processing, caching or event\-driven systems.



  





**Ownership Expectations** 




  





 At Troopd, you will be responsible for the
 **outcome of a feature, not just its implementation** 
 .
 



 This includes understanding requirements, documenting technical trade\-offs, identifying failure cases, coordinating dependencies, shipping safely, monitoring production behaviour and following through on issues after release.
 



  





**Why Troopd?** 




  





 Troopd is building
 **Agentic Colleagues** 
 that take ownership of defined business roles and execute the work associated with them.
 



  





 You will be joining at an
 **early stage** 
 , where the engineering team has a direct impact on the product, architecture and technology choices. You will work on real AI\-powered business applications, solve practical engineering problems and see your work move from idea to production.
 



  





 If you enjoy
 **building products end\-to\-end, working with modern AI/LLM technologies and taking real ownership** 
 , this is an opportunity to build something from the ground up.
 



  





**Apply if you have actually shipped AI/LLM\-powered functionality in production and want to build the next generation of AI\-native business applications.**

Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.
   

  

**Full\-Stack Developer (.NET \& ReactJS) with Test Management and Test Automation Experience**
 We are looking for a skilled .NET and ReactJS Full\-Stack Developer with experience in test management and test automation. In this role, you will develop and maintain business applications, support Azure and Office 365 integration, and help ensure quality through structured testing, defect management, and automated test coverage for UI, API, integration, and regression testing.
   

  

**Your Role**
* Develop, enhance, and maintain full\-stack applications using .NET (Core or Framework), ReactJS, RESTful APIs and Databases (like SQL Server, MongoDB or PostgreSQL).
* Implement responsive user interfaces, integrate business services, and support Azure and Office 365 application scenarios.
* Plan and coordinate testing activities, including test cases, execution, defect tracking, reporting, UAT, and release readiness.
* Design and maintain automated tests for UI, API, integration, and regression testing, including integration into CI/CD pipelines.
* Collaborate with developers, QA teams, and business stakeholders to deliver secure, maintainable, and high\-quality solutions.

* Master or Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* 5\-7 years of proven full\-stack development experience with .NET Core/.NET Framework, ReactJS, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, RESTful APIs.
* Hands\-on experience in test management, including planning, coordinating executions, defect management, reporting, and release validation.
* Experience with test automation frameworks and tools for frontend, backend, API, and regression testing, ideally integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
* Knowledge of Azure services, Office 365 development and integration scenarios, PowerShell scripting, and tools such as Azure DevOps or Jira.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience working in Agile development environments.
* Experience with structured QA processes, release validation, and user acceptance testing coordination.
* Familiarity with automation tools and frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, NUnit, xUnit, or similar.

 We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!

**Level Up Your Career!**
 At Kwalee, you’ll join a gaming powerhouse that boasts a mobile empire with 1\.5 billion\+ downloads alongside a thriving PC \& Console division that has achieved numerous global chart\-topping releases across Steam, Consoles, and Amazon, driving millions of Wishlists. Most recently publishing breakout hits such as The Precinct and Town to City. It’s a unique chance to bring your expertise to a global studio that dominates both the mobile, and the indie PC and Console space.
   

  

 At Kwalee, as well as a competitive salary we also offer; Private Medical Insurance, door\-to\-door transport scheme, free food \& drinks, free game codes \& merch, LinkedIn Learning, 20 annual leave days \+ bank holidays, and 1 day extra day for each year of service capped at 5\.
   

  

**Join the team!**
 As we continue to grow, we are now looking for a
 **Senior Fullstack Developer** 
 to join our AI \& Technology team.
   

  

 As a Senior Fullstack Developer, you will be responsible for building and shipping fullstack applications end to end. This role expands our senior depth to support our AI and Infrastructure work. You'll help fellow engineers get unblocked, lend a hand with DevOps and deployments, and deliver features acoss the stack that move the wider business forwatds.
   

  

 This is a permanent role based in our Bangalore studio, where our daily in\-office collaboration fuels creativity and innovation.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Design, build, and ship complete features across Python/FastAPI backends and React frontends.
* Build and maintain asynchronous APIs in Python and FastAPI, backed by sensible database design and secure server\-side logic.
* Deploy and harden containerised microservices with Docker so they hold up in production.
* Build frontends using Next.js, Vite, and TypeScript, with Tailwind CSS, Shadcn, and TanStack (React Query) for state.
* Integrate third\-party AI services such as the OpenAI APIs into live web applications.
* Make effective use of agentic coding tools like GitHub Copilot in VS Code to work faster without cutting corners on quality.
* Track down architectural issues and performance bottlenecks across the stack and fix them.
* Write and maintain tests to keep the codebase reliable as it grows.
* Review other developers' code and give clear, constructive feedback.
* Keep technical documentation up to date so the team can find what they need.
* Write clean, maintainable code that others on the team can build on.
* Work with our AI Engineers to stand up and stabilise the infrastructure behind new tools in the PCC and Mobile space.
* Support the DevOps team, helping keep our AWS environments and deployment pipelines in good shape as demand grows.
* Mentor fellow developers and share what you know as the team grows.
* Pitch in within a flat team structure, unblocking others and keeping delivery moving.
* Weigh in on decisions about scalability and how our systems should grow, without carrying formal management responsibility.
* Report to the Head of Engineering all relevant matters that affect your job and work.
* Fully comply with the companies procedures, processes, strategies and tactics as may be issued from time to time.
* Ad\-hoc other tasks which may arise from time to time and be assigned to you by the business.


**Fullstack Technical Expertise:**
* At least 5 years building asynchronous APIs with Python and FastAPI.
* A solid grasp of database design, secure server\-side logic, and keeping data intact.
* Experience deploying and running containerised microservices with Docker in production.
* Familiarity with Cloud hosting, deployment, and cloud infrastructure, AWS desirable.
* Comfortable working with Git in a collaborative, review\-based workflow.
* Hands\-on with agentic coding tools such as GitHub Copilot in VS Code as part of your day\-to\-day workflow.
* Strong React skills, specifically Next.js, Vite, and TypeScript.
* Comfortable with Tailwind CSS and Shadcn, and managing state with TanStack (React Query).
* Hands\-on experience wiring third\-party AI services like the OpenAI APIs into live applications


**Ownership \& Delivery:**
* You can dig into architectural issues and performance bottlenecks and sort them out.
* You write tests and review others' code as a matter of habit, not an afterthought.
* You deliver steadily and to a good standard while working across time zones with the rest of the team.
* You've shipped features end to end across both Python and React, not just one side of the stack.


**Mentorship and Cross\-Team Collaboration:**
* You enjoy coaching other developers and levelling up the people around you, without needing to be their manager.
* You're happy to help out with DevOps and infrastructure alongside your own work.
* You can talk through trade\-offs on scalability and design clearly, with both engineers and leadership.
* You care about clean, maintainable code and work in a way that lifts the whole team.


**Why Kwalee?**
* Generous Holiday: Start with 20 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays. You'll also earn an extra day for every year of service, up to 5 years!
* Flexible Working: We offer core hours that allow you to work flexibly around your life, and a bank of 'Work From Home' days to use when you need them.
* Health Cover: Private Medical Insurance covering you and your family
* Free Food \& Drink: Fuel your day with unlimited free snacks and drinks.
* Gaming Goodies: Receive Steam codes for all our game releases!
* Transport: Save on your commute with our budget\-friendly, door\-to\-door transport facility.
* Office Location: Work from our Bangalore office immersing yourself in the dynamic heart of India's Silicon Valley, where explosive career opportunities seamlessly blend with a vibrant, cosmopolitan lifestyle and fantastic year\-round weather.
* Professional Development: Take advantage of our corporate LinkedIn Learning subscription to enhance your skill set
* Merch \& Events: Get exclusive Kwalee merch, enjoy fun seasonal events, and stay informed with regular town halls.


**Our Commitment to Diversity \& Inclusion**
 At Kwalee, we take pride in being an equal opportunity employer, where we believe that diversity and inclusion are essential to driving creativity. We are committed to creating a safe, welcoming, and supportive environment where everyone can thrive.
   

  

 Our culture is built on celebrating the diverse voices of our team members, fuelling innovation and strengthening our connection to our players. We are dedicated to advancing equity, diversity, and inclusion across all areas of life, including age, disability, gender identity, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, and sexual orientation.
   

  

 We recognise the importance of self\-development, career progression, and well\-being in retaining our talented team. At Kwalee, we celebrate individuality and encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

 AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3\) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2\), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.
   

  

 Are you interested in building hyper\-scale database services in the cloud? Do you want to revolutionize the way databases are built for the cloud ? Do you want to have direct and immediate impact on hundreds of thousands of users who use AWS database services?
   

  

 Amazon Aurora is a MySQL and Postgres compatible, relational database service that combines the speed and availability of high\-end commercial databases with the simplicity and cost\-effectiveness of open source databases. It provides up to five times better performance than MySQL at a price point one tenth that of a commercial database while delivering similar performance and availability. Amazon Aurora is powered by an auto\-scaling, auto\-healing, distributed storage cluster of massive world\-wide scale.
   

  

 Amazon Aurora Storage platform team is looking for experienced software engineers who are excited about building large scale systems spanning tens of thousands of servers, across multiple data\-centers worldwide. These are core systems development positions where you will own the design and development of significant software components critical to our industry leading database services architected for the cloud.
   

  

 In this hands on position you will be asked to do everything from building rock\-solid components to mentoring other engineers. You need to not only be a top software developer with a good track record of delivering, but also excel in communication, leadership and customer focus. This is a unique and rare opportunity to get in on the ground floor within a fast growing business and help shape the technology, product and the business. title: Full-Stack AI Engineer
description:
**Location:** 
 Remote (India\-based) — Bengaluru preferred; with meaningful daily overlap with our UK and US teams
   

  

**Engagement Type:** 
 Full\-time — permanent, ongoing
   

  

**About MarcoPolo Learning**
 MarcoPolo Learning is a leading provider of innovative content, technology, and instructional support for early childhood education. Since 2013, we’ve impacted thousands of classrooms and hundreds of thousands of families across North America. Our Emmy\-nominated MarcoPolo World School app and The Polos TV series bring STEM and global discovery to life for young learners.
   

  

 Backed by top\-tier investors, we’re on a mission to transform early learning at scale. At the center of that mission is Audrey, our AI Teaching Companion \& Coach — a guided AI assistant that helps early\-learning educators plan lessons, discover the right materials, and improve classroom outcomes. We’re looking for a Full\-Stack AI Engineer to help bring Audrey to life and shape where she goes next.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 This is a role for an engineer who loves working where AI meets product. You’ll own the intelligence behind Audrey — the retrieval, generation, and logic that make her genuinely useful to teachers — while being just as comfortable moving across the backend and frontend to bring the whole experience together. You’ll work alongside our backend, infrastructure, and frontend engineers, with real ownership of the AI and real influence over what we build.
   

  

 Audrey is approaching an exciting launch, and you’ll play a central part in shaping her — refining how she works today and helping define where she goes as we grow into more classrooms.
   

  

 Just as much as the engineering, we care about instinct for the product. We’re looking for someone genuinely curious about the teachers we serve — an engineer who asks the right questions, understands how educators actually use what we build, and lets that understanding shape the experience. You’ll bring deep AI expertise, a natural instinct for collaboration, and a calm, considered approach to solving hard problems.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the AI at the heart of Audrey — retrieval, generation, and the models and logic that make her intelligent and dependable.
* Craft an experience where teachers instantly find exactly the right video, printable, or activity, with retrieval that’s fast, accurate, and reliable.
* Build and refine the content and data pipelines that power Audrey — ingesting and structuring videos, printables, guides, and multilingual content for precise retrieval.
* Work across the full stack, connecting the AI seamlessly into the wider product alongside our backend and frontend engineers.
* Shape how Audrey thinks, responds, and guides teachers — designing her behavior, personality, and overall experience with the end user always in mind.
* Help bring Audrey to launch and shape her evolution as we scale.
* Continuously raise the quality, speed, and reliability of Audrey’s responses and recommendations.
* Build fluently with modern AI\-assisted development tools to design, build, and iterate quickly.
* Partner with our infrastructure lead to keep Audrey running smoothly and efficiently in the cloud.
* Put in place the evaluation, testing, and monitoring that keep quality high, and keep technical documentation clear.
* Collaborate closely and openly with engineering and product, sharing your thinking and progress early and often.
* Help shape the product roadmap — from deeper personalization to multilingual support and classroom insights.
* Build with privacy and safety in mind, including FERPA/COPPA alignment.


**What We’re Looking For**
* 5\+ years of software engineering experience across the full stack, comfortable working fluidly between backend and frontend.
* Proven, hands\-on depth with modern AI: you’ve personally built and shipped at least one production LLM/AI application. We know the LLM tooling is only a few years old — what you’ve actually built matters far more to us than years on a résumé.
* Strong experience building retrieval\-augmented (RAG) systems — embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, and re\-ranking — with a real feel for what makes retrieval accurate and dependable.
* An AI\-native engineer who builds fluently with modern AI\-assisted development tools (e.g. Cursor) and weaves AI through their workflow.
* Strong Python and solid backend fundamentals (APIs, databases, data pipelines), with enough frontend ability to work end\-to\-end across the stack.
* Practical LLM orchestration and prompt engineering (LangChain or comparable), including agent/tool design, system\-prompt and persona design, and guardrails.
* Solid AWS experience (compute, storage, databases, containers, monitoring); familiarity with managed model services (e.g. Amazon Bedrock) and/or self\-hosted model inference is a plus.
* A genuine product sensibility — you’re curious about the people who use what you build, and you let that shape your work.
* A natural collaborator who communicates openly, builds trust across teams, and brings a calm, considered approach to a fast\-moving environment.
* Comfortable owning your work and driving it forward with minimal oversight.
* Able to work remotely with meaningful overlap across UK and US time zones, with strong written communication.
* Bonus: edtech or early\-childhood education experience; multilingual retrieval; video/audio ML; familiarity with FERPA/COPPA or similar.


**What We Offer**
* Competitive, market\-aligned salary for an experienced engineer in India.
* Fully remote, full\-time role with flexibility over how you structure your day.
* End\-to\-end ownership of the AI behind a flagship product, from launch through scale, with real influence over its architecture and roadmap.
* A collaborative, family\-friendly, mission\-driven environment at the intersection of education, media, and technology.


**Why Join Us**
 This is a rare chance to own the AI capabilities of a growing global education company at a defining moment. You’ll be the engineer who brings Audrey to life, shapes how she’s built, and helps take her from launch to a product used in thousands of classrooms. If you want work that’s visible, technically meaningful, and genuinely impactful for young learners and their teachers, this is it.
   

  

*Note: This is an India\-based engagement. Applicants must have the right to work in India; visa sponsorship is not available at this time.*
 MarcoPolo Learning is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. We pride ourselves on a supportive and mission\-driven working environment.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
**About ClearGrid**
**ClearGrid is revolutionizing the debt resolution industry with cutting\-edge AI and advanced analytics. We leverage real\-time data, machine learning, and automation to optimize debt recovery for financial institutions. As we scale our technology platform, we are building high\-performance, user\-centric systems to support our next phase of rapid growth.**
****Role Overview****
**Based in our Bangalore, India office, the Full Stack Engineer will bridge the gap between user experience and robust backend functionality. This role requires a versatile engineer with 3\+ years of experience who loves moving fast, taking end\-to\-end ownership of features, and building intuitive user interfaces backed by resilient architectures.**

****Technical Oversight \& Architecture****
* Full\-Stack Development: Design, develop, and maintain responsive, intuitive front\-end user experiences alongside high\-performance microservices.
* Component Design: Architect modular, reusable UI components and scalable backend endpoints that ensure smooth data synchronization and minimal latency.
* Database Integration: Design and optimize database schemas and queries across relational and NoSQL databases to support new application features.


****Execution \& Strategy****
* Feature Delivery: Drive features from conception to deployment, balancing short\-term delivery with long\-term code maintainability.
* Security \& Clean Code: Implement secure coding practices on both the client and server sides, ensuring secure authentication and data protection.

****Team Leadership \& Collaboration****

****Executive Reporting****
* Status Visibility: Keep engineering leads and product stakeholders informed on technical trade\-offs, sprint progress, and potential timeline dependencies.


**Requirements**
****Experience****
* Years of Experience: 3\+ years of professional full\-stack development experience in a fast\-paced environment.
* Industry Context: Experience working within startups, fintech platforms, or fast\-growing SaaS companies is highly valued.
* Geographic Location: Ability to work full\-time out of our Bangalore, India office.


****Technical Skills****
* Front\-End Stack: Deep proficiency in modern JavaScript/TypeScript and frameworks like React.js (or Vue.js/Angular), HTML5, and CSS3\.

****What We’re Looking For****

description:
**About Team**
 Walmart is a multi\-national people led tech powered omnichannel retailer with over 2\.2M associates. At People Support Tech, EBS we help, support and empower the Walmart’s HR function with AI and GenAI solutions to improve productivity, harnessing the opportunities for growth, focusing on well\-being and cultivating cultures of belonging for all Walmart's associates. Our team is responsible for transforming the People Help Center experience that is being leveraged by 2\.2M associates through different voice and chat channels.
   

  

 The vision is to deliver a radically efficient, deeply empathetic People Services experience where associates get what they need the first time—with clarity, speed, and zero unnecessary effort. By leveraging AI, the system anticipates and resolves associates’ queries on HR functions like Benefits, Payroll etc. before they become human contacts, ensuring proactive support for associates. Additionally, human agents are empowered with context, judgment support, and automation, allowing them to deliver faster, more accurate assistance while focusing on meaningful interactions. This approach enhances productivity, cultivates a culture of belonging, and completely transforms the HR Help Center Experience for all Walmart's associates.
   

  

 Our team is seeking a Senior Software Engineer (Full\-Stack) to help design and build scalable, user\-facing systems that power AI\-enabled People Support experiences. In this hands\-on role, you will work across backend services and modern web frontends, with a primary focus on backend system design, APIs, and integrations. You will collaborate closely with product, design, and ML partners to deliver reliable, performant solutions that directly impact millions of associates.
   

  

 Walmart’s Enterprise Business Services (EBS) is a powerhouse of several exceptional teams delivering world\-class technology solutions and services making a profound impact at every level of Walmart.
   

  

 As a key part of Walmart Global Tech, our teams set the bar for operational excellence and leverage emerging technology to support millions of customers, associates, and stakeholders worldwide. Each time an associate turns on their laptop, a customer makes a purchase, a new supplier is onboarded, the company closes the books, physical and legal risk is avoided, and when we pay our associates consistently and accurately, that is EBS. Joining EBS means embarking on a journey of limitless growth, relentless innovation, and the chance to set new industry standards that shape the future of Walmart.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

 Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and APIs using Java, Node.js (TypeScript), and Python to support AI\-driven web and conversational applications
   

  

 Build and enhance user\-facing web applications using React, collaborating with designers and product managers to deliver intuitive and performant experiences
   

  

 Implement and operate real\-time conversational and search capabilities, supporting chatbot and virtual assistant experiences through backend orchestration and service integration
   

  

 Integrate backend systems with ML and GenAI services, working closely with ML engineers to ensure reliable, observable, and production\-ready integrations
   

  

 Design and evolve service contracts, data models, and workflows across microservices and event\-driven architectures
   

  

 Contribute to system reliability, scalability, and performance, applying best practices in caching, concurrency, error handling, and capacity planning
   

  

 Write high\-quality, well\-tested code, participate actively in code reviews, and uphold engineering best practices across backend and frontend components
   

  

 Collaborate cross\-functionally with product managers, designers, ML engineers, and other developers to translate business requirements into technical solutions
   

  

 Participate in production support and on\-call rotations, helping diagnose issues, resolve incidents, and implement long\-term fixes
   

  

 Continuously improve developer productivity and system quality by adopting appropriate tools, frameworks, and engineering practices
   

  

 What you will bring
   

  

 6\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong emphasis on backend development and full\-stack delivery in production environments
   

  

 Strong backend development experience in Java/Spring Boot, Node.js/TypeScript, and/or Python
   

  

 Hands\-on experience building modern web applications using React, with a solid understanding of frontend fundamentals, state management, and API\-driven UI development
   

  

 Experience building and operating distributed systems, including microservices, asynchronous processing, and data\-intensive workflows
   

  

 Exposure to real\-time systems, such as conversational interfaces, chatbots, search, or decision\-support platforms, with an understanding of latency and reliability considerations
   

  

 Solid API design skills, including RESTful APIs, service contracts, versioning, and integration patterns
   

  

 Experience integrating with AI/ML or GenAI services, focusing on backend orchestration, reliability, and performance rather than model development
   

  

 Working knowledge of data storage systems, including relational and NoSQL databases, and an understanding of trade\-offs in data modeling and access patterns
   

  

 Understanding of security fundamentals, including authentication, authorization, and secure API development
   

  

 Experience with observability tools, including logging, metrics, and basic tracing, to support debugging and production readiness
   

  

 Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills, with the ability to work across backend and frontend layers to diagnose issues
   

  

 Effective communication and collaboration skills, with a willingness to learn, give feedback, and grow within a team\-oriented environment
   

  

 A sense of ownership and accountability, with a bias toward writing clean code, improving systems incrementally, and delivering customer value
   

  

**About Walmart Global Tech**
 Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That’s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We’re a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world’s leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. title: Senior Full Stack Developer - Node.js/React.js
description:
**About The Role**
 This is not a role where you maintain a dashboard and close tickets. We build AI\-native enterprise software. Real\-time multilingual voice, heavy data pipelines, multi\-tenant systems, and interfaces that thousands of people sit inside all day, across India, the UK and Europe.
   

  

 The work is hard in the way good engineering work is hard. Latency budgets you actually have to hit. Queries that fall apart at scale unless you think about them properly. UI that has to stay responsive while streaming data in from three places at once.
   

  

 If you like being handed a spec and told what to type, this will not suit you. If you like owning a hard problem end to end and being the person accountable for it, keep reading.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
**On the backend:**
* Design and own services in Node and TypeScript, sitting on PostgreSQL.
* Model data properly. Normalised where it matters, denormalised where it earns you something. You should be comfortable reasoning about foreign keys, partial and composite indexes, and what a covering index actually buys you.
* Read query plans. Kill N\+1s. Understand connection pooling, transaction isolation levels, advisory locks, and why a long\-running transaction on a hot table ruins everyone's afternoon.
* Build multi\-tenant boundaries that hold. Tenant scoping, RBAC, row\-level isolation, audit trails. Getting this wrong in enterprise software is not a bug, it is an incident.
* Work with event\-driven flows. Queues, workers, retries with backoff, idempotency keys, dead letter handling, backpressure. Exactly\-once is a lie, design for at\-least\-once and make it safe.
* Caching that is actually correct. Cache\-aside patterns, TTL strategy, stampede protection, distributed locks, and knowing when invalidation is the wrong answer.
* Real\-time paths. SSE and WebSockets, streaming responses, connection lifecycle, reconnection semantics.
* Integrate with enterprise systems designed in a different decade. Legacy file transfer, XML and SOAP\-ish APIs, webhook contracts, OAuth flows, rate limits you do not control.


**On The Frontend**
* Build in React and TypeScript on a modern Next.js setup. Server components, client components, and a clear head about which does what and why.
* Streaming SSR, suspense boundaries, route\-level code splitting, and hydration behaviour you can explain rather than guess at.
* Own Core Web Vitals. LCP, INP, CLS. Bundle analysis, dependency pruning, font and image strategy, no waterfalls in the data layer.
* Complex stateful UI. Server state in a proper query cache, client state kept minimal, optimistic updates, race condition handling, stale data reconciliation.
* Data\-dense interfaces done well. Virtualised tables, infinite scroll, filter and sort state in the URL, forms with schema validation on both sides of the wire.
* Real\-time UI that does not thrash. Streaming tokens, live status, presence, without re\-rendering the world every tick.
* A design system that stays consistent. Typed component APIs, sensible primitives, accessibility that is not an afterthought.


**Across Both**
* Own features from schema to screen. You design the tables, write the API, build the UI, ship it, and watch what happens after.
* Review code seriously and push back when something is wrong.
* Argue about what to build, not just how.


**The Kind Of Stack You'll Be In**
* Languages: TypeScript end to end, SQL.
* Frontend: React, Next.js, a component library, utility CSS, schema validation.
* Backend: Node.js, a lightweight HTTP framework, a typed query layer, REST and streaming APIs.
* Data: PostgreSQL, Redis, object storage.
* Cloud: AWS across multiple regions. Serverless functions, managed queues, CDN, managed Postgres and cache.
* AI layer: LLM APIs, function calling, streaming inference, real\-time voice.


 You do not need every one of these on your CV. You do need to be the kind of engineer who picks up a new one over a weekend and is useful on Monday.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
* 5 to 7 years building production web systems. Real users, real load, real consequences when it breaks.
* Deep TypeScript. Generics, discriminated unions, inference. You use the type system to prevent bugs, not to decorate the code.
* Strong React. You know why a component re\-rendered and how to stop it. You know when memoisation helps and when it is cargo cult.
* Genuinely comfortable in a database. You can write the SQL yourself and you know what the ORM is doing when you don't.
* You have designed an API someone else had to consume and it held up.
* You have debugged something in production under pressure and written up what went wrong afterwards.
* You write code a stranger can read in six months.


**On background:** 
 We lean towards engineers who have worked at a startup where they had to own a lot without a playbook, or who come from a strong engineering school (IIT, NIT, BITS, IIIT and similar). Both is ideal. Neither is a dealbreaker if the work speaks loudly enough. Send the GitHub, the side project, the thing that got used.
   

  

**Nice To Have**
* Worked with LLM APIs, streaming completions, prompt and eval design, or real\-time voice.
* Built multi\-tenant B2B SaaS with enterprise customers.
* Performance work you can talk about specifically. What was slow, what you measured, what you changed.
* Open source contributions, or a technical blog where you explain things properly.
* You have been the first or second engineer on something.


**What Working Here Is Like**
* Fast. Really fast. Decisions get made in one conversation, not across weeks of meetings. There is no ticket queue you sit in. If you see something broken you fix it.
* You get the whole picture. Founders sit in the same room. You will know what we are prioritising and why.
* The flip side is ownership. Nobody chases you for status. Ship it, tell the team, move on.


**What You Get**
* Competitive salary, benchmarked properly for senior engineers in Bengaluru.
* Real ownership of systems that carry weight, not a slice of someone else's feature.
* Hard problems, short feedback loops, and no layers between you and the outcome.
* A team where you will not be the smartest person in the room every day.
